changes.comment: A command that the client runs in-process for a routing reason now says why in one stderr line (in agent output, or when RUSH_DAEMON=1 asked for the daemon), and shows no "connecting to rushd" progress line. When the daemon can't be reached, the line has the same form, `rush-client: <reason>; using in-process Rush.`, and rushx-client names itself in these lines. `rush -q build` and `rush --quiet build` are sent to the daemon; other options before the command still run in-process.
